name: Dance Princess of the Ice Barrier
card_text: Once per turn, if you control another "Ice Barrier" monster: You can reveal any number of "Ice Barrier" monsters in your hand, then target an equal number of Set Spells/Traps your opponent controls; return those targets to the hand.
